subject: Senior IC-to-Manager Pathways & HR coordination
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@peopleops.io>
Date: 2026-11-15T08:32:00-08:00
Subject: Senior IC-to-Manager Pathways & HR coordination

Team —

Quick summary: I want to propose a targeted change to reporting lines and career-path mechanics for our senior platform and infra ICs that will: 1) create clearer manager pathways for high-performing senior ICs, 2) reduce ad-hoc people-management burden on product managers, and 3) preserve delivery velocity. This is sensitive — it touches performance reviews, potential promotions, and headcount.

High level proposal (attached: promotion-criteria-v1.xlsx, comm_plan-draft.md):
- Create two new “Pod Lead (Manager)” slots inside Platform (downstream of Platform Eng manager layer). These would be hybrid manager/tech-lead roles for ~2 teams.
- Convert up to 2 senior ICs to manager track (promotion + title change) following a calibrated review (pilot cohort Q1).
- For immediate capacity, recommend matrix reporting for 3 months (IC reports to manager for performance and to product lead for delivery).

Asks:
- Laura & Hannah: review the promotion criteria and flag any product/ops impact by EOW (Fri).
- Monica: confirm whether finance can provision 2 conversions within current headcount plan or whether we need additional approval.
- Claire (People Ops): advise on confidential promotion protocol, calibration cadence, and whether we can/should wait until annual review window.
- Lauren: take lead on comms draft for impacted folks (private first, team announcement later).

Risks: perceived favoritism, org churn, compensation budget. We need HR/legal sign-off on confidentiality. I’ve attached a draft comms plan and a simple promotion criteria worksheet.

If we agree, I’ll set a 60-minute calibration session next week (proposed Tue 11/17 10–11am PT).

Thanks —
Marcus
VP, Platform
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. A few HR considerations:
- Confidentiality: run discrete 1:1 conversations with eligible ICs. Use neutral language in private conversations; avoid promises until calibration and compensation approvals are complete.
- Calibration: we can run a focused 90-minute calibration workshop next Wed (11/24). I will bring a confidential packet template and sample manager competency matrix.
- Legal/Compliance: ensure we document selection rationale in case of disputes; avoid performance-related language that could be construed as disciplinary.
- Timeline recommendation: if we want promotions within Q1, we should aim to finalize decisions by mid-December to allow notice and comp processing.

I can produce a confidential-promotion-protocol.pdf and run manager training on how to have the private conversation. Let me know preferred dates.

Regards,
Claire Donovan
People Ops Consultant
peopleops.io
